body:
Hand-off from child 5 (#25752, the cutover procedure) to this card, 2026-10-26T07:50Z.

The switch is complete: `ui/` is on `main` (#25825), 4a #25745, PR B #25827 and 4b PR 2 #25834 are merged, the required set reads 8 live / 0 / 0 with no retired gate (Type Check UI, Lint UI and Build & E2E UI added; Test UI advisory per ruling 30 = B), and objectui is archived with the migration notice as its README head (#25854).

**Expected version of the first joint release: 18.2.0.** Both scopes are at 18.1.0 on `main` (`packages/spec`, `ui/packages/core`). The root `.changeset/` carries 55 minor and 84 patch bumps, so the fixed group moves one minor.

What this card still needs before the Version PR is cut, all already filed:
- #25831 (re-scoped by item 28 = B): one consolidated root changeset that names the public `@object-ui/*` packages as `minor`. Until it lands, a Version PR would not bump `@object-ui/*`, because changesets does not read `ui/.changeset/`.
- #25832: the objectui skill bundle moves into the root `skills/` catalog (decision C).
- The release npm token's publish rights on `@object-ui` and the docs-site deploy (#25752 step 6, maintainer settings).

The Version PR is merged only by a human. After it publishes, this card closes #25556 as superseded and then the epic #25677.
